nao_coberto.nota: The Master Theorem is not presented (only in the index: 'see recursion trees', p.454). Use recursion trees (JE p.49-52).
Minimax and alpha-beta do not appear. The game tree uses good/bad states (JE p.93).
Internal data structures are a prerequisite (JE p.6) and are not taught; refer to data-structures-expert.
The Knuth-Yao optimization is not covered.
LIS in O(n log n) by binary search is not covered; only O(n^2).
The König and Menger theorems are not stated (König only as a historical name, JE p.208, 374).
The book does not prove Cook-Levin (JE p.401-402).
Approximation algorithms and FPT are not covered.
Linear programming is not covered (Dantzig is cited only historically).
Hashing is only mentioned in passing (JE p.214, 216).
Randomized algorithms are out of scope (JE p.49, note 7).
Amortized analysis is only mentioned in passing (JE p.282-283).
Dinitz and push-relabel are only cited (JE p.359, 361); minimum-cost flow is not covered.
